title: OpenAI API will remove GPT-4o, GPT-4o mini, GPT-4.1 and GPT-4.1 mini on January 14, 2027
detail: On October 14, 2026 OpenAI notified developers that gpt-4o-2024-08-06, gpt-4o-2024-11-20, gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18, gpt-4.1-2025-04-14 and gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14 are deprecated and will be removed from the API on January 14, 2027. The recommended replacement for all of them is gpt-6-luna. Fine-tuned versions of these models follow the same shutdown schedule as their base models.
impact: Anyone still calling these models, including fine-tuned variants, has until January 14, 2027 before requests fail. Fine-tuned models have no direct replacement listed on the page, so moving to gpt-6-luna means re-running any fine-tuning work.
